subject: Discovery recap & legal routing for Redwood Pilot
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>

Subject: Discovery recap & legal routing for Redwood Pilot

James — great to meet today. Quick recap from our discovery and the items we agreed on for next steps so we can align the internal routing on both sides.

Summary of goals and scope:
- Pilot: 3-month pilot to evaluate Redwood inference for customer-facing summarization and search reranking (low-PII).
- Expected throughput: ~100 concurrent requests during daytime peak; batch/asynchronous workflows for nightly jobs.
- Success criteria: latency < 200ms median for interactive endpoints, cost target <$0.015/token, and acceptable hallucination rate on our eval prompts.

Stakeholder map (from the call):
- Day-to-day owner / PM: James Porter (you)
- Technical champion / SE: Michael Reyes
- Economic buyer: Michael Reyes (confirmed)
- Security/compliance reviewer: Emily Ross / procurement@northbridge.ai
- Legal for contracts: Emily Ross (procurement) and internal counsel (TBD)

Legal/contract sequencing I propose:
1) NDA (mutual) — quick sign so we can exchange test data and SOC 2 evidence; typical turn: 1-3 business days.
2) MSA (commercial terms) — we can share our standard MSA and accept initial redlines; typical first-pass turn: 3-5 business days from receipt.
3) DPA — we can share our template; depending on data residency requests, this can be negotiated in parallel with the MSA but prefer signature after MSA if there are extensive redlines.

Attachments I’m including: Redwood_NDA_v3.pdf and a draft SOW to help procurement scope the pilot. I’ll loop in our Legal and Security to speed reviews: Cc’d Rishi (legal liaison) and Dev (solutions/SE).

Next steps I need from your side:
- Confirm the procurement contact and the expected PO/billing process (Emily?),
- Confirm whether you need a proof-of-SOC2 report or any additional compliance docs,
- If you’re ok, I can send the NDA via DocuSign today.

Thanks — I’ll wait for confirmation and will kick off the NDA.

Best,

Marissa Cole
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference

Procurement notes and timeline (FYI from Emily in-thread):
- Typical NDA turnaround: 1–2 business days if using mutual NDA (we usually sign vendor NDAs quickly).
- MSA: 1–2 weeks depending on redlines (we have an internal review queue).
- PO issuance: after SOW + approved pricing; usually takes 7–10 business days once legal signs off.

We would appreciate getting the NDA via DocuSign today so Emily can route it to Legal. Also, can you include the SOC2 AOC and the DPA template in the same bundle if possible?

James

From: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwoodinference.com>

Thanks Rishi — quick answers and recommended plan: 

Turn times we typically see: 
- NDA (mutual): 1 business day internal turnaround; customer signature often 1–3 business days depending on procurement bandwidth.
- MSA initial redline (commercial/legal review): target 3–5 business days for Redwood Legal to provide a first pass after we receive customer redlines or confirm they will use our standard.
- DPA: we can circulate our DPA immediately and accept initial comments in parallel; however, if the customer’s DPA includes significant jurisdiction/residency clauses, those are likely to take longer.

Recommended sequencing: 
1) Execute mutual NDA immediately (DocuSign sent by Marissa).
2) While NDA is pending, share our clean MSA + exhibit pricing and ask the customer to flag any high-risk clauses up front (indemnity, data residency, security obligations).
3) We can review DPA comments in parallel but prioritize closing MSA commercially first; DPA signatures can follow MSA or run tandem if Northbridge procurement insists.

Requests from Sales to expedite: 
- Please provide the HubSpot deal id (HS-87521) and the planned PO/billing contact.
- Confirm whether Northbridge wants any additional security docs (ISO, penetration test reports) beyond SOC2 AOC — we can share the standard packet.

I’m attaching the MSA_redline_template.docx for Sales to share; I’ll queue this matter with priority and aim to turn on a first-pass redline within 3 business days after NDA countersignature or after we receive customer redlines, whichever is earlier.

Markus Klein
Senior Counsel, Contracts | Redwood Inference
markus.klein@redwoodinference.com
